slides.title: Stop cutting your podcast into random clips. It’s killing your reach.
body_points: Repurposing is not recycling; it is surgical adaptation of core assets for distinct audience behaviors.

slides.title: Key Insight & Framework
body_points: Match the format to the platform's native consumption habit.
Preserve the core insight, but rewrite the hook for that specific audience.
One asset must serve three distinct user intents.
slides.tip: High-retention hooks must interrupt the scroll in under 2 seconds.

body_points: Which platform drains your energy the most?
